nodes.label: Frame-interval target revision (absolute 25 ms)
nodes.rationale: Refresh-relative limit failed at 240 Hz even for a 0.26 ms Cursor effect, so it measured WPF composition, not effect cost

nodes.label: Numbered Schema 1 Migration Backup
nodes.rationale: Never overwrite a backup; an older binary cannot read newer schemas, so rollback restores the highest-numbered backup.

nodes.label: Dependabot FIX commit prefix
nodes.rationale: Dependabot cannot number branches, so its PRs are titled 'FIX: <summary>' and checked only by title.

nodes.label: Run /graphify --update before merging doc-only PRs
nodes.rationale: Git hooks rebuild the graph only after code changes, so doc-only changes need a manual update.

nodes.norm_label: manual checks marked unverified in pr validation

nodes.label: Test-first development rule
nodes.rationale: Tests must fail for the expected reason before code is written; bug fixes start with a reproducing test.

nodes.label: AppFailureLog
nodes.rationale: Queues records for a background writer; exit waits at most one second for drain; unwritten records may be lost.

nodes.label: tools/E2ERunner black-box runner
nodes.rationale: No project reference to DrawEM.App; own P/Invoke; never builds; tests published exe via SendInput.

nodes.label: Stage 1 Manual Desktop Gate
nodes.rationale: Unit tests cannot establish audible output or global input behavior, so a separate manual gate on the user's desktop is required.

nodes.label: DRAWEM_DATA_DIR override
nodes.rationale: Published app cannot start with known settings without overwriting the user's; one root resolved once in the composition root, no CLI arg or UI.

nodes.label: Managed Sound Library
nodes.rationale: Imports are copied into the user profile; originals never moved or deleted; unreferenced copies collected after Save and at startup, but skipped when settings are unreadable to avoid losing media.

nodes.label: Settings Persistence and Startup Fallback
nodes.rationale: Durable save before replacing active config; damaged settings file is retained for recovery and not overwritten by defaults.

nodes.label: Hook-Owned Shortcut Capture Mode
nodes.rationale: Hook stays installed and routes keys to the capture field; actions are not dispatched during capture so existing bindings can be recorded without triggering.

nodes.label: v3 Release Blockers (unverified layout/DPI/multi-monitor checks)
nodes.rationale: Checks 2.7, 2.8, 4.2, 4.3, 4.5, 6.1, 6.2 are Unverified because the environment lacks German/Polish layouts and a second monitor at different scaling.

nodes.label: Unintended input-layout switch is a release blocker
nodes.norm_label: unintended input-layout switch is a release blocker

nodes.label: Separate manual desktop results document
nodes.rationale: Automated tests or publish success alone do not close manual acceptance.

nodes.label: Abort on Physical Input
nodes.rationale: Runner hooks detect events lacking LLKHF_INJECTED/LLMHF_INJECTED and abort, releasing all pressed keys and stopping the app.

nodes.label: Neutral Key Injection VK 0xE8
nodes.rationale: Prevents Windows input-layout switch when an Alt+Shift or Ctrl+Shift action suppresses its key; tagged events are ignored by resolution and capture; bare modifier pairs still switch layouts.

nodes.label: Right Alt Reserved for AltGr
nodes.rationale: Current hook counts Right Alt as Alt so AltGr chords trigger Ctrl+Alt actions; v3 passes through while Right Alt is down. LLKHF_INJECTED is not an AltGr detector.

nodes.label: Program.Main custom WPF entry
nodes.rationale: VelopackApp.Build().SetAutoApplyOnStartup(false).Run() first; hooks fast-exit

nodes.label: Auto-apply on startup disabled
nodes.rationale: Silent apply-and-restart rejected in roadmap; R4-07 owns consent-based updates

nodes.label: Velopack package ID drawEM.Desktop
nodes.rationale: Must differ from drawEM so uninstall never removes %LOCALAPPDATA%\drawEM settings

nodes.label: SoundChannelController
nodes.rationale: Owns at most one playback attempt; new request stops the active player; ten-second deadline; stale callbacks ignored.

nodes.label: SoundChannelHost
nodes.rationale: Runs SoundChannelController on a dedicated STA thread so MediaPlayer stops at the deadline even when the UI thread is busy.

nodes.label: SoundAssignments (code-owned Slots)
nodes.rationale: Code-owned mapping of eight slots to external WAV/MP3 paths; empty by default so nothing is imported or copied. Retired in v3 in favor of saved user settings.

nodes.label: SoundConfiguration (Resolve / PathOf)
nodes.rationale: Resolve maps slot to command, PathOf maps sound to path; one sound with two different paths is rejected.

nodes.label: SoundFailureLog
nodes.rationale: Append catches I/O and access errors so logging cannot end the tray application.

nodes.label: LoggingSoundFailureReporter
nodes.rationale: Queues sound.log records for a background writer and drains at most one second on exit so disk I/O never blocks the sound thread.

nodes.label: MediaSoundPlayer (WPF MediaPlayer)
nodes.rationale: Wraps every WPF exception in SoundPlaybackException; single Release method runs each handler removal and Close in its own try, since removing MediaPlayer handlers can re-enter failing native engine setup.

nodes.label: SoundChannelController
nodes.rationale: Owns at most one playback attempt; stop-and-dispose old before new; releases player before reporting failure.

nodes.label: SoundChannelHost (dedicated STA sound thread)
nodes.rationale: Channel and every MediaPlayer live on a dedicated STA dispatcher thread so a busy UI thread cannot delay the ten-second deadline; MediaPlayer can be stopped only on its owning thread.

nodes.label: sound.log failure log (%LOCALAPPDATA%\drawEM\logs)
nodes.rationale: Failure record has timestamp, slot or sound id, path and reason; stored in user profile so logging never depends on executable location.

nodes.label: Eight Sound Slots Ctrl+Alt+1..8
nodes.rationale: Fixed code-owned slots; unassigned slot resolves to no command; Ctrl+Alt+Z and Ctrl+Alt+X stay fixed.

nodes.label: Global Single Sound Channel
nodes.rationale: One channel independent of drawing; new sound replaces active one, same sound restarts.

nodes.label: Eight Numbered Action Slots
nodes.rationale: Only sound is assignable in v3 but slots must allow other types later without redefinition.

nodes.label: Settings Window (Drawing and Actions tabs)
nodes.rationale: Edits are drafts until Save; Cancel leaves active config unchanged; Restore defaults affects only the draft.

nodes.label: Per-Attempt Generation Token
nodes.rationale: Each attempt object is its own generation token so stale completion, failure and timeout callbacks cannot stop a replacement.

nodes.label: Hook Queues Playback via Sound Dispatcher
nodes.norm_label: hook queues playback via sound dispatcher
nodes.rationale: Hook callback never opens files, decodes or starts players; it calls SoundChannelHost.Play to queue on the sound Dispatcher without waiting on the UI Dispatcher or drawing commands.

nodes.label: DrawingSessionController
nodes.rationale: Application layer; must not depend on IMonitorBoundsSource, so infrastructure clamps out-of-desktop points before forwarding.

nodes.label: Outside Edge rule
nodes.rationale: An edge with no adjacent monitor must not end drawing; only entering another connected monitor ends a stroke; points outside every monitor are clamped to the starting monitor.
